finding_wp1.m1_gap: This MT5 terminal's M1 history retention appears limited to roughly the trailing ~120 days from current server time (empirically verified: clean pulls at 30/60/90 days back, 0-1 bars at 120+ days back). Within that retention window, every EURUSD M1 interval is either CONSUMED (2026-05-18..2026-06-19 GEN_001, 2026-08-01..2026-09-14 GEN_002), UNRESOLVED/excluded (2026-06-20..2026-07-31), or the reserved post-2026-09-14 prospective/forward window this mission was explicitly told not to consume as an OOS substitute. No historical, untouched, in-retention M1 data currently exists. This is a genuine infrastructure/evidence gap, not a policy choice.
finding_wp1.next_safe_action: Resolve the M1 gap (e.g. a data source with deeper M1 retention, or an explicit owner-approved methodology decision on reduced fill-resolution precision for this pilot) before any canonical-parity SSC replay can be run against this OOS package. This is separate from, and in addition to, the P5/P6.1 TARGET_REACHED / OOS economic floor blockers recorded in SSC_ONE_DAY_DEMO_PILOT_V2.md and the SSC1D-WP1 status report.
